_comment: Single source of truth for Insights cards, NEWEST FIRST. To add an insight: create the article page, then add an entry at the TOP here. `npm run build` regenerates the homepage (latest 3) and /insights (all) automatically via scripts/render-insights.mjs.

insights.title: CBAM strategy for iron & steel: what exporters must decide in 2026
insights.dek: CBAM is now a carbon price at the EU border for steel — the widest scope, the highest emissions. Verified data vs default values, and how to turn it into an edge.

insights.title: CBAM in 2026: the definitive period, the Omnibus simplification, and what exporters must do now
insights.dek: From 1 January 2026 the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism stops being a reporting exercise and becomes a cost. Here is what changed, who is now exempt, and the moves that protect your margin.

insights.title: SBTi's Corporate Net-Zero Standard V2: what the draft changes — and how to prepare
insights.dek: In 2025 the Science Based Targets initiative opened a draft of Version 2 of its Corporate Net-Zero Standard for consultation. It is not final — but the direction is clear, and target-setting companies should prepare now.

insights.title: CDP after the overhaul: one questionnaire, IFRS-aligned, and how to score well
insights.dek: CDP consolidated its separate questionnaires into a single, IFRS-aligned disclosure on a new platform. Here is how the system now works, how scoring is decided, and what actually moves your grade.

insights.title: BRSR Core explained: India's assured sustainability disclosure and the value-chain ripple
insights.dek: India's BRSR has moved from narrative to assured data. BRSR Core requires reasonable assurance on a defined set of KPIs — and pushes ESG requirements down the value chain to unlisted suppliers.

insights.dek: As carbon requirements move from the company to the product, three acronyms dominate procurement conversations. They are related but not interchangeable — and choosing the wrong one wastes months.

insights.dek: Seven commodities banned from the EU market unless proven deforestation-free and traceable to the plot. What EUDR demands — and how to prepare.

insights.dek: EcoVadis scores suppliers on four themes, with medals on a percentile curve. What the score really rewards — and how to move from Bronze to Gold.

insights.dek: ISCC EU, PLUS, CORSIA and Carbon Footprint serve different markets. How to choose the right certification — or the right combination.

insights.dek: Scope 3 is typically 70–90% of your footprint and the hardest to measure. The 15 categories, the methods that work, and where to start.

insights.dek: IFRS S1 and S2 are the global baseline for sustainability and climate disclosure. What they require, who must comply, and how to prepare.

insights.dek: The carbon market has split on integrity — ICVCM defines the credit, VCMI the claim. What separates a quality carbon asset from a liability.

insights.dek: The gap between a net-zero pledge and a funded plan is a cost curve, a capital plan and financing. How to build a business case the board approves.
